title: Grand Theft Auto 2
text:
Grand Theft Auto 2, also known as GTA 2, is a computer game released worldwide on October 22, 1999 by developers DMA Designs (now Rockstar North), initially for Windows and PlayStation, but later ported to Dreamcast and Game Boy Color. It was preceded by the controversial original 1997  hit Grand Theft Auto, and followed by Grand Theft Auto III.

Windows and Dreamcast versions are both rated M by the ESRB, but language and violence were toned down for PlayStation and Game Boy Color versions, which received a T rating: fewer kills are needed to pass jobs or Kill Frenzies, and the player's vehicle can explode after running over a large number of gang members. 

The Windows version was later released as a free download.

Story
The player is a man later identified as Claude Speed, freed from prison after being awakened from a cryonic sleep, but experiencing amnesia. The storyline shifts to his goal of becoming the "King of the Kennel" by any means necessary.

Unlike other games in the series, GTA2 is set in a metropolis known only as Anywhere City, and in an unspecified time: the game manual uses the phrases "three weeks into the future", "X weeks into the future" and "X minutes into the future", which commonly suggest "near future", while fictional journal entries on the GTA2 website suggest the year 2013, but in the game itself radio host Johnny Riccaro mentions "the millennium's coming," which would set the game in 1999, the year of its initial release.

Gameplay
The player explores multi-level city districts, earning money by committing crimes until having the Target  for that district, allowing the player to leave the area and start play in the next one.

Anywhere City consists of three areas, or districts: the first is the Downtown District, which contains hotels, a Casino, the Sunnyside mental institution and City University; the second is the Residential District, which contains a Mobile RV Park with an Elvis-themed club called Disgracelands, Alma Mater Prison, the Scientist Research Center and the H2000 Water Company's hydroelectric generator; and the third and final area is the Industrial District, which contains the Docks, a meat processing plant and the Krishna Vedic Temple.
